name: Rebuild Model Site on Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel Deploy Hook
        env:
          VERCEL_HOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}
        run: |
          echo "Triggering Vercel deploy hook..."
          curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}' "$VERCEL_HOOK_URL"
